answer: Agents trading relic appraisals, nectar deliveries and juniper seedlings govern their marketplace through stake-weighted votes: each token must stay locked for 30 days, and splitting tokens among accounts does not increase their total voting weight. Creating a million identities therefore buys no extra influence. To outvote honest agents, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens than they collectively stake, tying up capital and bearing price risk.
